out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' OBSERVED NO SIGNED COPIES OF EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY ON SITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS PROVIDED COPY OF EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY TO PIC DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE REVIEW WITH EMPLOYEES AND HAVE EACH SIGN A COPY. MAINTAIN SIGNED COPIES ON SITE FOR REVIEW BY THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE CHANGING GLOVES AFTER HANDLING RAW LAMB WITHOUT WASHING HANDS BEFORE ATTEMPTING TO DON CLEAN GLOVES.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REMOVE GLOVES AND WASH HANDS BEFORE DONNING CLEAN GLOVES. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEES TRAINING AND CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: OBSERVED EMPLOYEE BAKING FLAT BREADS AND HANDLING WITH BARE HANDS AFTER REMOVING FROM OVEN.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH HANDS AND DON GLOVES TO HANDLE BREADS AFTER COOKING. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE. OTTOMAN KITCHEN (Inspection Date: 05/18/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at handwashing sink AT END OF COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC PROVIDED HAND SOAP DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASH SINK IS ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW MEATS OVER PREPARED LETTUCE AND ONIONS IN TRUE 1 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR; RAW BEEF STORED OVER YOGURT AND RAW SHELL EGGS STORED OVER MILK IN M3 TURBO 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EMPLOYEE REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: RAW CHICKEN STORED ABOVE BEEF AND LAMB IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). EDUCATION PROVIDED. EMPLOYEE REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SHREDDED MOZZARELLA AT 44F AND GROUND LAMB AND BEEF MIX AT 45F IN AVANTCO RAIL; SLICED TOMATOES AT 54F, TZATZIKI AT 62F, BABA GANOUSH AT 63F, HUMMUS AT 64F IN COLD SERVICE TABLE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC WILL USE TIME AND APPLIED LABLES TO DISCARD UNUSED OR UNSOLD FOODS AT 5:00PM.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: LENTIL SOUP, TZATZIKI, TOMATO SAUCE AND ROASTED EGGPLANT PREPARED 2 DAYS PRIOR WITHOUT DATE MARKING IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: BOWL STORED IN RICE COOKER USED TO DISPENSE RICE.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REMOVED BOWL DURING INSPECTION AND REPLACED WITH SPOON. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS WILL EMAIL SIGNAGE TO PIC. PIC ORDER SIGNAGE DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW BEEF STORED ABOVE TZATZIKI AND TOMATO SAUCES; OBSERVED RAW CHICKEN ABOVE COOKED GROUND BEEF IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REORGANIZE READY TO EAT FOODS ABOVE RAW MEATS.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: OBSERVED RAW MARINATED CHICKEN STORED ABOVE RAW MARINATED BEEF IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REORGANIZE MEATS BY COOK TEMPERATURES.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED LENTILS SOUP AT 128F IN STEAM TABLE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REHEAT LENTIL SOUP TO 165F OR ABOVE TO FURTHER HOLD HOT AT 135F OR ABOVE. OTTOMAN KITCHEN (Inspection Date: 11/22/2024) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED TZATZIKI SAUCE AND TOMATO SAUCE PREPARED FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS WITHOUT DATE MARKING.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO PLACE LABELS WITH APPROPRIATE DATE MARKING DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED OILS AND SAUCES IN KITCHEN STORED DIRECTLY ON THE FLOOR; OBSERVED BEVERAGES IN DINING AREA AND BACK HALLWAY NEAR EXIT STORED DIRECTLY ON THE FLOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS ARE ACQUIRED TO STORE FOOD 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wipings Clothes Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counters IN BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. OTTOMAN KITCHEN (Inspection Date: 11/22/2024) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the CHLORINE/BLEACH sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO OBTAIN CHLORINE/BLEACH TEST KIT. PIC ORDERED CHLORINE TEST KITS DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in restroom used for males/females.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. PLEASE PROVIDE COVERED BIN. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED IN NEXT INSPECTION.
